episodes.title: Of Mice and Men
episodes.summary: A burned-out attorney gets a second chance for redemption when he agrees to pursue a wrongful death lawsuit against the biggest client of his former law firm.

episodes.title: Pride and Prejudice
episodes.summary: Billy scrambles to get his wrongful death lawsuit into court by any means necessary.

episodes.title: Game On
episodes.summary: The judge gives Billy only a day to make a compelling offer of proof before he dismisses the lawsuit.

episodes.title: It's Donald
episodes.summary: The beginning of discovery unearths a startling new piece of evidence that threatens to unravel Billy's entire theory of the case.

episodes.title: Cover Your Ass
episodes.summary: As both sides begin their depositions, more secrets start to come to the surface, threatening to destroy everyone involved.

episodes.title: Line of Fire
episodes.summary: Billy has to go to great lengths to secure his physical evidence's safety and preserve his witnesses' credibility.

episodes.title: Beauty and the Beast
episodes.summary: With danger mounting around every corner, Billy has to decide whether to head directly to trial or take his chances with a continuance.

episodes.title: Citizens United
episodes.summary: The trial concludes as former partners and old friends have their final showdown in court.

episodes.title: La Mano
episodes.summary: Billy McBride is reluctantly pulled back into criminal defense when his friend's 16- year-old son is arrested for a double murder.

episodes.title: Politics
episodes.summary: After a brutal loss, Billy decides to formally take on Julio Suarez's defense, but before he can go back to court, he has to get his team back together first.

episodes.title: Fresh Flower
episodes.summary: When Billy learns the name of the real shooter, he has to turn to the FBI to help him bring his elusive suspect in for questioning.

episodes.title: Alo
episodes.summary: Billy tries a risky strategy to suppress the prosecution's two key pieces of evidence, hoping he can clear Julio's name before trial even begins.

episodes.title: Who's Gabriel
episodes.summary: Billy finally gets a witness who can exonerate Julio, but he won't talk unless Billy can convince the prosecutor to give him a deal.

episodes.title: Two Cinderellas
episodes.summary: Believing his client will soon be a free man, Billy joins Marisol for a romantic weekend in Mexico, only for his case to fall apart at home.

episodes.title: Diablo Verde
episodes.summary: Held hostage by strangers and with no memory of how he got there, Billy has to make a harrowing escape from Mexico.

episodes.title: Tongue Tied
episodes.summary: On the night of the mayoral election, Billy and his team race to take down the people responsible before they become an unstoppable Goliath.

episodes.title: The Subsidence Adventure
episodes.summary: The unexpected death of an old friend takes Billy McBride to California's Central Valley, where a record drought has made water more valuable than human life.

episodes.title: Happiness from the Ground Up
episodes.summary: Billy's investigation into the Central Valley's water problem threatens the launch of Diana Blackwood's almond-based lifestyle brand.

episodes.title: Good Morning, Central Valley
episodes.summary: As Billy and Patty begin a class action lawsuit against the corporate farmers, the Blackwoods start dealing with everyone who gets in their way, including Billy.

episodes.title: Full Circle
episodes.summary: Flashing back to before the events of the season, Billy has a drunken weekend at the Rising Sun Hotel and Casino, crossing paths with the Blackwoods and their scheme to steal water.

episodes.title: Argus 2: Battledome
episodes.summary: As Billy and Patty make their first appearance in court, their class action is threatened when they walk into traps set for them by the Blackwoods.

episodes.title: Fer-De-Lance
episodes.summary: Billy and Patty grill the Blackwoods in their depositions, shining a light on their complicated relationship and how they obtained ownership of the county's water supply.

episodes.title: Conscious Uncoupling
episodes.summary: Billy puts Wade Blackwood on the stand and under oath, forcing him to admit every detail of his scheme to steal the state's water.

episodes.title: Joy Division
episodes.summary: As Billy and Patty close in on the Blackwoods, Wade tries to cover up their crimes while Diana makes one final, desperate play, regardless who gets in her way.

episodes.title: Hadleyville
episodes.summary: In the final season, Billy returns to his Big Law roots after Patty takes a job at a prestigious white-shoe law firm in San Francisco. Together, they try to take down one of America's most insidious Goliaths: the opioid industry.

episodes.title: The Pain Killer
episodes.summary: Patty finds herself on the hook for Billy's behavior as he digs deeper into the case.

episodes.title: Signed, William Hamilton McBride
episodes.summary: As Billy and Sam grow closer, he discovers that the opioid industry is keeping bigger secrets than he ever imagined.

episodes.title: Forcibly Removed
episodes.summary: Billy goes to extremes to keep the case alive, and Sam questions whether bringing him on board was a good idea after all.

episodes.title: Spilt Milk
episodes.summary: As Billy faces repercussions from his conduct, he is forced into a truce with an old adversary.

episodes.title: Rundleworks
episodes.summary: Billy and Patty take measures to protect a witness, while the partners at Margolis & True scramble to strengthen their case.

episodes.title: Lawyer Trickery Bullshit
episodes.summary: When Patty calls a surprise witness to the stand, the defense does everything they can to undermine the witness's credibility.

episodes.title: It's Time
episodes.summary: In a final showdown with George Zax, Billy and Patty seek justice for the victims of the opioid epidemic, no holds barred.
